en: A color-printed vintage postcard showing a river or wide stream curving through a forested landscape with rocky cliffs on the right side. Coniferous trees cover the slopes and shoreline, and a narrow path or rail/road with a simple wooden railing runs along the base of the rocky cliff beside the water. The style resembles an early 20th‑century tinted lithograph. At the bottom left in red print is a caption identifying the view.
